info.title: Notify Universal API
info.description: Send web push notifications to Notify channels, inspect channel metadata and recent delivery results, and manage browser subscription payloads against notify.run.

post.description: Creates a new channel in Notify.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

channel_page.description: The browser subscription page URL for the channel.

channelId.description: The newly created Notify channel identifier.

endpoint.description: The channel endpoint URL used to send notifications.

messages.description: Recent messages on the new channel, usually empty immediately after creation.

pubKey.description: The VAPID public key used for browser subscriptions.

time.description: Provider time marker returned by the channel info response.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
